name: godot-mcp
description: Godot 4 engine integration — scene management, script generation, export to PC/Android/Web
install_hint: 1) Install Godot 4: download from godotengine.org  2) pip install gdmcp  3) Set enabled=true

mullm_tools.name: godot_create_scene
mullm_tools.description: Create a new Godot scene with a given root node type

mullm_tools.name: godot_export
mullm_tools.description: Export Godot project to a target platform

mullm_tools.name: godot_run_script
mullm_tools.description: Run an arbitrary GDScript or Python script inside Godot
